pages.description: SPARKA soft toy, football/green Playing with balls is fun and something the whole family can enjoy together. With a soft ball, a football game can be played anywhere indoors – regardless of season and weather.
pages.ld_description: SPARKA Soft toy - football/green. Football or something else that’s fun? This soft and light ball is perfect when your child wants to play indoors. Being physically active helps your child develop their motor skills and coordination, while forming a healthy habit for life. Only for indoor use.
